name: Giant Crocodile
printing: Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, released in 2025. Current publisher digital text.
operationalEvidence: Hold Breath lasts one hour. Multiattack includes one attack of each kind. Bite restrains a qualifying creature while held and excludes it from Tail. Tail knocks a qualifying target Prone on a hit.
errataEvidence: The publisher’s version 1.0 errata does not list an update for this creature.
habitatEvidence: The publisher stat block lists Coastal, Swamp.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on the verified reused portrait.

name: Giant Frog
printing: Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, released in 2025. Current publisher digital text.
operationalEvidence: Bite grapples targets up to Medium. The separate Swallow action takes a target up to Small that is already grappled. Its acid damage applies at the end of the frog’s next turn, followed by expulsion if the target survives.
errataEvidence: The publisher’s version 1.0 errata for p. 357 changes the original +4 Bite attack bonus to +3. The digital stat block reflects the correction and retains Stealth +4 and Bite damage of 5 (1d6 + 2).
habitatEvidence: The publisher stat block lists Forest, Swamp.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on the verified reused portrait.
